posts.title: Do You Know Which Java Build You Are Running?
posts.description: At the JFall Conference in November (Ede, The Netherlands) I talked to a lot of Java developers and DevRel colleagues, and I asked everyone the same question: which Java version do you run? Most said 21, and a growing group said 25. That made me happy, because both are recent Long-Term Support (LTS) releases. Until a few years ago, the answer still included a lot of 8 and 11…

posts.title: Foojay Podcast #105: Security Is Your Job: OWASP, AI and Safer Java Dependencies
posts.description: How safe is your Java application, and how safe are the dependencies it ships with? For Foojay Podcast #105, I talked with Jim Manico , founder of Manicode Security, Java Champion and OWASP project leader, about what OWASP is, how he revived its Java libraries with AI-assisted workflows, and why security is your responsibility as a developer.
